name: Taquitos with Creamy Salsa Verde by Herdez®

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk together the Herdez® salsa verde, cream cheese, and 1 cup of sour cream until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Reserve 2 cups of this mixture for serving. To the remaining mixture, add the shredded chicken and Mexican cheese blend; stir until well combined.

Wrap the tortillas in a clean, damp kitchen towel and microwave on low for 1 minute until pliable. Place a warmed tortilla on a flat surface and scoop approximately ¼-cup of filling horizontally across the bottom. Roll the tortilla tightly and set aside, seam-side down. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
In a medium saucepan, heat oil over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F. Working in batches, fry the taquitos until golden brown, approximately 1-2 minutes per batch.

Briefly warm the reserved creamy salsa verde mixture. Plate the taquitos and top with the warmed sauce. Garnish with crumbled cotija, cilantro, and radish slices. Serve immediately with lime wedges and extra sour cream on the side.
